symbols.name: polynomial ring
symbols.meaning: The ring of complex polynomials in the formal variables θ_1 to θ_M.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{P}$ be the ring of complex polynomials in the formal variables $\theta_1,\dots,\theta_M$, where $M$ is the number of variables.

symbols.name: formal variable
symbols.meaning: A formal variable of the polynomial ring, indexed from 1 to M.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{P}$ be the ring of complex polynomials in the formal variables $\theta_1,\dots,\theta_M$, where $M$ is the number of variables.

symbols.name: variable count
symbols.meaning: The number of formal variables θ_1 to θ_M.
symbols.quote: Let $\mathcal{P}$ be the ring of complex polynomials in the formal variables $\theta_1,\dots,\theta_M$, where $M$ is the number of variables.

symbols.name: relation
symbols.meaning: The i-th relation, a polynomial in the polynomial ring that is set to zero in the quotient.
symbols.quote: Let $f_1,\dots,f_K$ be polynomials in $\mathcal{P}$, the relations, where $K$ is the number of relations.

symbols.name: relation count
symbols.meaning: The number of relations f_1 to f_K.
symbols.quote: Let $f_1,\dots,f_K$ be polynomials in $\mathcal{P}$, the relations, where $K$ is the number of relations.

symbols.name: ideal of relations
symbols.meaning: The ideal generated by the relations, the set of all sums of the relations multiplied by polynomials.
symbols.quote: The ideal generated by the relations, $J$, is the set of all sums of the relations multiplied by arbitrary polynomials $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_K$:

symbols.name: multiplier
symbols.meaning: The polynomial multiplier of the i-th relation in a sum that belongs to the ideal.
symbols.quote: The ideal generated by the relations, $J$, is the set of all sums of the relations multiplied by arbitrary polynomials $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_K$:

symbols.name: polynomial
symbols.meaning: A polynomial in the polynomial ring, identified with another when their difference lies in the ideal.
symbols.quote: Two polynomials $\phi,\psi$ are identified when $\phi-\psi\in J$, and the class of $\phi$ is written $[\phi]$.

symbols.name: polynomial
symbols.meaning: A second polynomial in the polynomial ring, identified with another when their difference lies in the ideal.
symbols.quote: Two polynomials $\phi,\psi$ are identified when $\phi-\psi\in J$, and the class of $\phi$ is written $[\phi]$.

relations.quote: With one variable and the single relation $y^r+1$, the quotient ring is reduced to the [Polynomial ring modulo yʳ + 1](polynomial-ring.md), whose elements are the polynomials of degree less than $r$.
